status_definitions.complete: Workflow and required evidence are complete at a green exact revision.
status_definitions.partial: Some implementation exists, but workflow or acceptance evidence remains open.
status_definitions.excluded: Outside the offline product boundary, with a documented reason.

capabilities.title: Detached Omarchy launcher
capabilities.limits: The supported live summon kept Quickshell responsive and the detached native process survived an Omarchy shell restart at exact published SHA f6b0cb7e55d296bdf77714efc48a1775b858c041. At exact published SHA 4b31024426b73fafe93597e4cd42312eef2b26b0, the normal native Wayland launch and isolated live missing-binary and immediate-exit-42 branches delivered their exact critical notifications, diagnostics, and statuses without altering the installed package or leaving a process/window behind.

capabilities.title: Exact-revision Arch package
capabilities.limits: Rust and exact-revision Arch package CI is green at published application SHA d1f82f8eb90c29ce25c80963083634dd6e1a105e, where a clean container built, tested, and installed solitaire-omarchy 0.1.0.r0.gd1f82f8-1. The preceding published SHA 860413721e62d8967a938a04562491919b219ab5 independently built and installed solitaire-omarchy 0.1.0.r0.g8604137-1. At earlier installed SHA d20ba4111deb2e948e593fbeec4ca2c45b597bef, the installed source marker, nine package files, and binary hash were verified with no altered files. The evidence package is unsigned; reproducibility, signed checksums, SBOM, and release-upgrade evidence remain open.

capabilities.title: Bounded atomic local persistence
capabilities.limits: Real Wayland save/reopen in all five games, corrupt-profile quarantine, dirty close guarding, and two-process stale-writer recovery succeeded at published alpha SHA f6b0cb7e55d296bdf77714efc48a1775b858c041. Crash injection, cross-file transactions, and power-loss acceptance remain pending.

capabilities.title: Playable Klondike
capabilities.limits: The native new-deal controls expose draw-one, draw-three, Standard, and Vegas scoring; focused controller coverage preserves all four exact choices through atomic save/reopen. Malformed option requests are rejected before deal-number reservation and preserve the current game, save, counter, and pending request. An installed keyboard stock draw, undo/redo, and save/reopen were accepted at exact SHA f6b0cb7e55d296bdf77714efc48a1775b858c041. The Vegas UI workflow still needs exact-package Wayland acceptance. Both scoring modes are untimed with unlimited stock passes; timed play, limited redeals, left-handed layout, drag/drop, a complete-deal win presentation, and broader platform evidence remain open.

capabilities.title: Playable Spider
capabilities.limits: At exact installed SHA d20ba4111deb2e948e593fbeec4ca2c45b597bef, keyboard selection, stock deal, undo/redo, save/reopen, and AT-SPI identity/action semantics passed in one-, two-, and four-suit modes. The two-suit pass also accepted a legal cross-suit build and atomic rejection of a mixed-suit run. Dependency-free hostile-action and fixed seed/mode action-space tests cover rejection atomicity, card conservation, exposure invariants, replay reconstruction, and undo/redo. A pinned normal one-suit replay now reconstructs through production code to a one-move 7/8 state, and controller coverage proves the final keyboard-routable move, exact 8/8 status, 0600 replay save, and idempotent 1/1 profile across undo, redo, repeated observation, and loader-level reopen. The exact installed final-transition and normal Controller startup/reopen gate and drag/touch behavior remain open.

capabilities.title: Playable FreeCell
capabilities.limits: FreeCell accepts strict decimal u64 deal numbers through a dedicated keyboard/accessibility-declared surface. Focused controller coverage rejects malformed, non-ASCII, overflowing, and oversized input atomically; exact choices including 0 and the u64 maximum survive dirty-state confirmation and save/reopen without consuming the durable next-deal sequence. A subprocess Controller startup test proves that reopening the maximum exact deal preserves and can advance the separately persisted next sequence, while the displayed string preserves the full range. These numbers reproduce this repository's generator and do not claim interoperability with another product's numbering. A pinned normal seed-zero replay reconstructs through production code to one legal foundation move before victory; controller coverage proves the keyboard-routable final move, exact complete status, 0600 replay/profile saves, one-time played/won accounting, undo/redo idempotence, and loader-level reopen. A background source launch preserved the foreground and an isolated headless compositor started the source UI, but its missing virtual-keyboard protocol prevented safe interaction. An installed deterministic hint, illegal move, legal keyboard move, and save/reopen were accepted at exact SHA f6b0cb7e55d296bdf77714efc48a1775b858c041. The numbered-entry gate, exact installed final foundation move, solver-grade hints, drag/touch, and broader platform evidence remain open.

capabilities.title: Playable Pyramid
capabilities.limits: Standard Pyramid is playable with deterministic numbered deals, pair-to-13 and king removal, two redeals, bounded replay/history, atomic local save/recovery, and declared keyboard/accessibility semantics. A pinned normal seed-zero replay reconstructs through production code to one legal pair before victory; controller coverage proves the keyboard-routable final selection/pair, visible win status, 0600 replay/profile saves, exact played/won accounting, undo/redo idempotence, and loader-level reopen. An installed keyboard stock draw and save/reopen were accepted at exact SHA f6b0cb7e55d296bdf77714efc48a1775b858c041. The exact installed final transition, solvability metadata, optional variants, drag/touch, and spoken assistive-technology acceptance remain pending.

capabilities.title: Playable TriPeaks
capabilities.limits: Standard mode is playable with deterministic numbered deals, bounded replay/history, atomic local save/recovery, and declared keyboard/accessibility semantics. A pinned normal seed-zero replay reconstructs through production code to one legal move before victory; controller coverage proves the keyboard-routable final removal, visible win status, 0600 replay/profile saves, exact played/won accounting, undo/redo idempotence, and loader-level reopen. An installed keyboard stock draw and save/reopen were accepted at exact SHA f6b0cb7e55d296bdf77714efc48a1775b858c041. The exact installed final transition, optional modes, drag/touch, and spoken assistive-technology acceptance remain pending.

capabilities.title: Local profiles, statistics, and achievements
capabilities.limits: One anonymous device-local profile exposes per-game deals played and won using idempotent numbered-deal observations, fixed-size u64 counters, bounded atomic persistence, CAS conflict handling, retry/close guards, and corrupt-source quarantine. Controller coverage proves exact FreeCell, TriPeaks, and Pyramid played/won transitions persist once across undo, redo, repeated observation, and reopen. Real Wayland played/reopen in all five games plus quarantine/conflict workflows succeeded; installed won-deal transitions, named profiles, achievements, streaks, import/export, sync, multi-process merge, cross-file transactions, power-loss acceptance, and broader statistics remain pending.

capabilities.title: Keyboard and assistive-technology acceptance
capabilities.limits: Real Wayland keyboard navigation/activation, visible focus, AT-SPI names/actions/states across all five games, and changing live-region names were observed at exact SHA f6b0cb7e55d296bdf77714efc48a1775b858c041. At exact installed SHA d20ba4111deb2e948e593fbeec4ca2c45b597bef, all three Spider modes and the complete wrapped long-status keyboard/AT-SPI workflow passed. FreeCell, TriPeaks, and Pyramid now have keyboard-routable normal near-win candidates, but their exact-package final actions and live-region transitions remain open. The FreeCell numbered-entry exact-package input gate, full keyboard-only traversal, and Orca spoken output also remain pending.

capabilities.title: Real Omarchy and Wayland acceptance
capabilities.limits: At exact SHA f6b0cb7e55d296bdf77714efc48a1775b858c041, installed legal mutation/save/reopen in all five games, plugin summon, shell responsiveness, native-process survival across shell restart, quarantine, conflict recovery, and clean shutdown were observed on real Omarchy/Wayland. At exact installed SHA d20ba4111deb2e948e593fbeec4ca2c45b597bef, one-, two-, and four-suit Spider workflows and the wrapped long-status surface passed focused Wayland acceptance. At exact SHA 4b31024426b73fafe93597e4cd42312eef2b26b0, normal and both launcher-failure paths passed live acceptance. The FreeCell, TriPeaks, and Pyramid complete-deal fixtures are automated candidate evidence only; their exact-package final transitions remain open. The FreeCell numbered-entry installed input gate, Orca, other complete-deal UI wins, and drag/touch remain pending.
